item.title: Angel Studios' 'David' brings in over $70M after highest grossing faith-based animated film opening
item.description: Angel Studios’ “David” has now brought in more than $70 million at the box office after making more money on ticket sales during its opening weekend than any other faith-based animated movie in history. #AngelStudios #KingDavid #InternetMovieDatabase

item.title: Pastor assassinated during New Year’s Eve celebrations in Colombia
item.description: A 54-year-old Protestant pastor was shot and killed by armed men on New Year’s Eve in northern Colombia as he gathered with his family. The killing took place in the Santa Elena neighborhood of Fundación Municipality in the Magdalena Department. #Colombia #Assassination #NewYearsEve #Pastor #Christianpersecution #JosOtonielOrtega

item.title: Grok chatbot can undress women 'without their consent,' anti-exploitation group warns
item.description: Anti-sexual exploitation advocates are warning that Grok, a chatbot developed by Elon Musk’s company xAI, has the ability to generate nude or obscene images if users ask it to digitally alter pictures of real people. #NCOSE #Grok #ElonMusk #artificialintelligence #chatbot

item.title: Tim Allen reveals he's studying Apostle Paul’s teachings on law, sin amid spiritual journey
item.description: Actor and comedian Tim Allen recently revealed his interest in faith, philosophy and the foundations of Christianity has led him deep into the writings of the Apostle Paul, particularly Paul’s teaching that law exists to expose humanity’s sin. #TimAllen #BillMaher #ApostlePaul

item.title: Judge backs Christian dad seeking to opt kid out of LGBT kindergarten lessons
item.description: A federal judge has ruled in favor of a Christian parent seeking to have his kindergarten-aged child removed from classroom lessons on sexual orientation and gender identity as litigation surrounding the matter continues. #Education #LGBTideology #kindergarten #parentalrights

item.title: 7 notable US-backed regime changes since WWII
item.description: For much of its history, the U.S. has engaged in various efforts to influence or change the regimes of other nations, either through invasion, multinational intervention or covert backing of factions. #coup #Venezuela #Maduro #Noriega #Iran #ColdWar #Libya #history

item.title: Wyoming Supreme Court strikes down abortion bans, rules women have right to make 'own health care decisions'
item.description: Wyoming’s highest court has struck two state abortion bans, affirming a lower court decision. #Wyoming #SupremeCourt #abortion #prolife #amendment #constitution

item.title: Hobby Lobby’s David Green urges Christians to rethink success, offers wisdom on leaving a lasting legacy
item.description: In a culture that often measures success by personal achievement, wealth and recognition, David Green, founder and CEO of Hobby Lobby, contrasts this with the assurance that a life that matters is defined not by what someone accumulates but by what they set in motion for generations to come. #DavidGreen #HobbyLobby #legacy

item.title: Gospel star Donnie McClurkin accused of raping, sexually assaulting former male assistant: lawsuit
item.description: A new lawsuit accuses Grammy-winning gospel star Donnie McClurkin, who built his ministry and a church on his powerful testimony of being delivered from a life of abuse and homosexuality, of repeatedly sexually assaulting and raping a man who once served as his personal assistant at Perfecting Faith Church in Freeport, New York. #DonnieMcClurkin #Gospelsinger #rape #sexualassault #lawsuit #GuiseppeCorletto

item.title: 5 things to know about Venezuela's oil industry, US involvement
item.description: President Donald Trump asserted over the weekend that reopening Venezuela and its vast crude oil reserves to American oil companies is a key goal as the United States seeks to "run" the OPEC country, following the U.S. capture of former Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro. Here are five key facts about the oil industry in Venezuela. #Venezuela #oil #energy #NicolsMaduro
